cards.head: What does 'active recall' mean?
cards.answer: Forcing yourself to retrieve an answer from memory rather than passively re-reading. One of the highest-impact study techniques known.

cards.head: How does spaced repetition work?
cards.answer: Cards you struggle with appear more often; cards you know well appear less frequently. Intervals grow exponentially as confidence rises.

cards.head: What is interleaving in studying?
cards.answer: Mixing multiple topics in a single session rather than blocking one at a time. Feels harder but produces better long-term retention.

cards.head: What is the FSRS algorithm?
cards.answer: Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler — a modern open-source algorithm that models memory decay more accurately than the older SM-2.
